cohort: The study participants were 116 women diagnosed with postpartum depression in North-Central Nigeria.
finding: Women with postpartum depression had significantly poor perception of Quality of Life across all domains, with education, age, modes of delivery, and complications during delivery identified as independent correlates influencing various QoL domains.
mod_finding: Modes of delivery were found to be an independent correlate associated with the physical domain of Quality of Life perception (b = -0.28, p =.016).
cross-section timing: during the postpartum period, after diagnosis of postpartum depression
